# Autotex (Autotex Aircon Enterprise)

> Kia and Hyundai parts stockist in Kaki Bukit, Singapore. Stocks parts direct from Korea and sells direct to Singapore drivers. Pick your car and part, see the price where listed or ask on WhatsApp.

Last updated: 2026-11-07

## Business details
- Registered name: Autotex Aircon Enterprise, UEN 52353300D, registered 24 February 1995
- Address: 1 Kaki Bukit Avenue 6, #01-42, AutoBay@Kaki Bukit, Singapore 417883
- Opening hours: Mon-Fri 9:30am-5:30pm, Sat 9:30am-3:30pm, Sunday closed
- Phone: 6747 9618. WhatsApp: +65 9731 9547
- Google rating: 5.0 from 4 reviews
- Prices: listed on the product page where set; otherwise quoted on WhatsApp. Autotex confirms stock and fit (by car plate or chassis number) before payment
- Ordering: add parts to the cart and send the order on WhatsApp. Collect at the shop, or delivery within 1 day at S$10, free above S$80. Returns within 7 days in the original packaging

- Signs of a failing alternator on a Hyundai or Kia: Battery warning light, dim lights or a car that stalls can point to a failing alternator. Signs on a Hyundai or Kia, and how to tell it from a flat battery. https://autotexautoparts.com.sg/articles/signs-of-a-failing-alternator/
